title: private-deployment-orion-weekly-sync-2026-08-24
content:
Weekly sync notes — Orion private deployment (VPC/on-prem)
Date: 2026-08-24
Owner (notes): Ava Martinez
Attendees: Ava, Marco, Sofia, Ethan, Priya (Orion infra), Samir (Orion security) — Priya joined late
Status summary (quick):
- Overall: on track for initial canary by 2026-08-31 if current network/firewall blocker cleared.
- Remaining risky items: external egress for Redwood agent, KMS access pattern, image registry access for air-gapped nodes.

Agenda covered:
1) Network & firewall rules (blocker)
2) Image registry / air-gap plan
3) KMS / key access and HSM integration
4) Deployment timeline / canary plan
5) Action items and owners

Notes / details:
1) Network & firewall rules (BLOCKER)
- What happened: customer infra (Samir) confirmed corporate firewall currently blocks inbound connections from Redwood-managed IP ranges for our preflight probes and the agent callback channel. They also have strict egress restrictions to external registries.
- Impact: prevents automated preflight checks and remote agent provisioning; blocks ability to pull images from Redwood public registry.
- Discussion: Priya to file an internal change request to allow the following temporary exceptions for initial rollout:
   * allow outbound HTTPS to registry.redwood.ai:443 from the cluster nodes
   * allow inbound TCP 5222 (agent callback) from Redwood control plane IP set (we provided the IP list)
- Decision: Orion agreed to approve an exception window of 72 hours for initial canary; security will review post-canary for longer-term policy.
- Owner: Priya Nair (Orion) to create change request today; Samir to expedite (said likely by 8/26).

2) Image registry / air-gap plan
- If firewall exception not available in time, fallbacks:
   1) customer to mirror container images into internal registry (preferred fallback). Marco sent a tarball + manifest to Priya earlier today.
   2) offline image import procedure documented in confluence (linked).
- Owner: Marco to follow up with a checksumed tarball and step-by-step import steps by 8/25. Priya to confirm internal registry credentials by 8/26.

3) KMS / key access and HSM integration
- Priya reiterated Orion wants keys to remain in their HSM; Redwood to use customer-managed KMS. We outlined two options:
   A) short-lived signing tokens (recommended for speed)
   B) full KMS integration via mutual TLS and our KMS adapter (longer runway).
- Action: Sofia to draft KMS integration checklist and required IAM policies by 8/27.
- Risk: if we go with full adapter, additional network ports and cert rotations are needed (call out to SRE & infra).

4) Deployment timeline / canary plan
- Proposed canary: 3 nodes, limited traffic (internal traffic only) leading up to progressive rollout if stable for 48h. Target canary date 2026-08-31 assuming firewall exceptions or mirrored images ready.
- Rollback plan: disable routing to canary; automated config to revert to hosted model variant if canary fails healthchecks. Ethan to validate revert automation.
- Owner: Ethan Brooks to validate rollback/runbook and smoke tests by 8/28.

5) Misc infra items
- DNS: Orion DNS team needs to add A records for agent endpoints; Priya to confirm name and TTL by 8/26.
- Metrics / logging: Ensure Prometheus scrape endpoints are accessible within VPC; Marco and Ava to test after agent connect.

Action items (explicit)
- Priya Nair (Orion): Open change request for firewall exceptions (allow registry.redwood.ai:443 outbound and inbound agent callback IPs) — due 2026-08-26.
- Samir (Orion security): Review & expedite approval once CR filed — target 2026-08-26.
- Marco Li (Redwood): Deliver checksumed image tarball + import steps to Priya and upload to shared confluence — due 2026-08-25.
- Marco Li (Redwood): Test image pull via mirrored registry once creds provided — due 2026-08-26.
- Sofia Patel (Redwood): Draft KMS integration checklist and required IAM policies — due 2026-08-27.
- Ethan Brooks (Redwood): Validate rollback automation/runbook + smoke tests for canary — due 2026-08-28.
- Ava Martinez (Redwood): Coordinate Prometheus/logging smoke test after agent connection and confirm dashboards — due 2026-08-31.

Open questions / parking lot:
- If firewall exceptions are refused, what is committed SLA for push installs vs. customer pull? Need to decide whether Redwood will send operators or ship an ISO. (parking for legal/ops).
- Long-term: HSM integration timeline — feasibility for production before GA. Need SRE estimate.

Decisions made this meeting:
- We proceed with canary plan aimed for 2026-08-31 contingent on network exceptions or mirrored images.
- Use temporary 72-hour exception window for initial provision; security will perform post-canary review.

Next steps / next meeting:
- Next weekly sync booked: 2026-08-31 10:00am PT (aim: canary readiness check-in).
- If Priya/Samir get approvals earlier, we'll spin up a preflight run and ping the team in Slack (#orion-private-deploy).

Notes to self (Ava):
- Remind engineering to keep verbose logs for first 48h of canary (we want token-level cost + latency traces).
- Prep a short customer-facing one-pager on rollback & incident response to share during canary kickoff.

-- end of notes --
